scientific_choices.choice: Inspected local sections 3.3/3.5 and Algorithm 2. Whole-image fallback is retained; this new region/cost router is an approximate extension, not the paper router.

Reuse frozen YOLO640/PARSeq, original RGB-derived word evidence, Text/Kernel predicted probability maps, TRAIN80/45 and TEST300, complete ViTAEv2-S+TextOCR branches, exact casefold word-multiset/native256 ignore protocol and all983/2204 care words.

A full predicted component is a missing-region candidate if area>=4, uncovered pixels>=4 and uncovered fraction>=0.5; cross-head corroboration requires support>=0.25. Padding canvas is excluded geometrically, with no annotation validity masks.

Region counts and uncovered mass divided by predicted-word foreground mass are missing-word proxies, not measured missed words. Positive per-word median supplies the mass scale; predicted-component median is the fallback and empty maps are neutral.

Native confidence and geometric mean of confidence, frozen CLIP rank and crop agreement are uncalibrated word evidence. Risk is twice summed word-error proxy plus a missing-region proxy. No learned weights, classifier, training, new model inference or word-output changes.

Freeze all eight new rules, primary family and settings before new TEST features. TRAIN80 selects family by final microF1 at each fixed budget; TRAIN45 independently supplies inclusive scalar cuts. Rank budgets and transferred scalar cuts remain distinct. All families and controls are reported.

Paired10000-image bootstrap fixes gates, with no multiplicity correction. Primary family and TRAIN-selected family are both compared with frozen base_proxy_f1 and complete DeepSolo. Zero or unfilled acceptance is explicit, never counted as a routing gain.

Predicted masks can miss or hallucinate text; components can fragment/merge words. Historically explored TEST, repeatedly reused TRAIN, DeepSolo Total-Text TRAIN fine-tuning, paper metric/checkpoint equivalence and total probe latency limit generalization and superiority claims.
